items.name: json-inspector

items.name: kbd

items.description: A custom scroll area built on Base UI.

items.description: A select control built on Base UI.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A visual separator built on Base UI.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A side sheet built on Base UI dialog primitives.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: A responsive application sidebar with menu, rail, and provider primitives.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A loading placeholder with shimmer animation.

items.name: sonner
items.title: Sonner
items.description: A themed toast provider for Sonner.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: A compact loading spinner using Lucide.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: A tabs primitive built on Base UI.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A tooltip primitive built on Base UI.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: Resizable panel primitives using react-resizable-panels.

items.name: csv
items.title: CSV parser
items.description: A small, dependency-free RFC 4180-ish CSV/TSV parser returning a header and rectangular rows.

items.name: csv-viewer
items.title: CSV Viewer
items.description: A virtualized CSV/TSV table on TanStack Virtual: sortable columns, sticky header, row numbers, horizontal scroll. Renders straight from raw rows (no table row model) so it stays flat in memory on huge files.

items.name: pdf-viewer
items.title: PDF Viewer
items.description: A pdfjs-backed PDF viewer: continuous scroll, controlled or uncontrolled zoom, rotate, fit-to-width, download, a per-page overlay slot for bounding-box citations, a PdfHighlight overlay, and an imperative scrollToPageTarget handle for driving source highlights.

items.name: docx-viewer
items.title: DOCX Viewer
items.description: A docx-preview-backed Word viewer: faithful paginated pages, continuous scroll, zoom, fit-to-width, and download. Off-screen pages are skipped via CSS content-visibility.

items.name: image-viewer
items.title: Image Viewer
items.description: A performant image viewer with native off-thread decode (createImageBitmap), continuous scroll, zoom, rotate, fit-to-width, download, and a per-frame overlay slot. Renders multi-page TIFF scans efficiently: frames decode lazily near the viewport and decoded bitmaps are capped. No useEffect.

items.name: pptx-viewer
items.title: PPTX Viewer
items.description: A canvas-backed PowerPoint viewer rendered entirely client-side (no server conversion): continuous scroll, zoom, rotate, fit-to-width, download, and a per-slide overlay slot. Slides render lazily near the viewport and renders are serialized.

items.name: xlsx-worker-protocol
items.title: XLSX worker protocol
items.description: Typed worker messages, parse limits, and error codes for the XLSX viewer.

items.name: xlsx-workbook
items.title: XLSX workbook model
items.description: Sparse compact workbook helpers for the XLSX viewer: cell lookup, metadata projection, column labels, and bounded source caching.

items.name: xlsx-sheetjs-flattener
items.title: XLSX SheetJS flattener
items.description: Pure SheetJS-to-compact-sheet flattening helpers for the XLSX viewer worker.

items.name: xlsx-viewer
items.title: XLSX Viewer
items.description: A virtualized Excel/spreadsheet viewer rendered entirely client-side: sheet tabs, zoom, download, formatted values, numeric alignment, sparse workbook storage, and row + column virtualization so huge sheets stay smooth. No useEffect for data loading.

items.name: file-viewer
items.title: File Viewer
items.description: One viewer for any file: detects the type and lazy-loads the matching renderer (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, CSV, images) plus inline, virtualized text/code/JSON, Markdown (sandboxed), and HTML (sandboxed). Only the needed parser is ever downloaded.

items.name: document-source
items.title: Document source model
items.description: Viewer-agnostic model for extraction sources (the Retab /v1/extractions/{id}/sources shape): SourceAnchor union (pdf_bbox, image_bbox, spreadsheet/csv cell, docx/text span), Source, ExtractionSourcesResponse, and extractionSourcesToSourceMap to flatten the sources tree into a path-keyed SourceMap.

items.name: use-source-link
items.title: useSourceLink
items.description: Generic, viewer-agnostic mediator linking a field emitter (json-form, a field list) to a document viewer: owns the hover-vs-pin state machine, resolves the active field to a location via an injected SourceTarget, and drives the viewer's scroll. Unidirectional.

items.name: pdf-source
items.title: PDF source adapter
items.description: Bridges the document-source model to the PDF viewer: pdfAnchorToLocation (normalized bbox → page %), usePdfSourceTarget (a SourceTarget over a PdfViewer ref), and renderPdfSourceOverlay (draws a PdfHighlight on the active source's page).

items.name: segments
items.title: Segments model
items.description: Shared model + helpers for page-segmented results (partition/split): Segment type, Tableau palette, color map, page-range and confidence helpers.

items.name: segment-interaction
items.title: Segment Interaction
items.description: React-free hover, focus, selection, and current-page helpers for Segment[] surfaces.

items.name: use-segment-interaction
items.title: useSegmentInteraction
items.description: Client hook that coordinates hover, focus, and persistent selection across Segment[] surfaces.

items.name: segment-legend
items.title: Segment Legend
items.description: Compact color legend for a Segment[] with shared hover, focus, and selection state.

items.name: segment-sidebar
items.title: Segment Sidebar
items.description: Selectable list of segments with page ranges and confidence bars.

items.name: page-timeline
items.title: Page Timeline
items.description: A colored page strip that ties a Segment[] to the document; hover/select syncing and click-to-jump.

items.name: segmented-document-viewer
items.title: Segmented Document Viewer
items.description: Composes SegmentSidebar + SegmentLegend + PageTimeline + an optional PDF document with per-segment color overlays. The shared engine behind partition and split viewers.

items.name: page-ribbon
items.title: Page Ribbon
items.description: A page-axis ribbon: segments drawn as blocks spanning their pages. One vertical lane = a split sidebar; many horizontal rows (consensus + votes) = a partition waterfall. Shared hover/focus/selection + click-to-jump.

items.name: schema-builder
items.title: Schema Builder
items.description: Controlled JSON Schema editor for building Retab extraction schemas — fields, types, nested objects, arrays, enums, and required flags.

items.name: file-thumbnail
items.title: File Thumbnail
items.description: Compact file preview shell with a loading shimmer, fade-in, and muted fallback surface. No renderer dependencies.

items.name: run-card
items.title: Run Card
items.description: A document run card: a file thumbnail with a status pill, a heading, and a result slot. Composes file-thumbnail; the result rendering is left to its children.

items.name: split-viewer-block
items.title: Split Viewer
items.description: Named subdocuments over a PDF: a legend header and a vertical page-ribbon sidebar, from the shared segment primitives.

items.name: partition-viewer-block
items.title: Partition Viewer
items.description: Keyed chunks over a PDF: a legend plus a horizontal page-ribbon waterfall, from the shared segment primitives.

items.name: parse-viewer-block
items.title: Parse Viewer
items.description: The source document beside its extracted markdown, synced by page, with a Rendered/Text toggle.

items.name: edit-viewer-block
items.title: Edit Viewer
items.description: Detected form fields beside a PDF source document, linked by their bbox — hover or select a field to highlight its region on the page; Preview stamps values over the source, and Filled renders a supplied output file.

items.name: extract-viewer-block
items.title: Extract Viewer
items.description: Extracted data beside the source PDF, rendered as a JSON form and linked by sources — hover or select a field to highlight where its value came from and scroll the page to it.

items.name: extraction-viewer-block
items.title: Extraction Viewer
items.description: Every extraction format in one viewer — PDF, image, text, CSV, Excel, and Word — each shown as a JSON form beside its source document, linked by their sources. Tabs switch the file format; hovering a form field highlights where its value came from. One useSourceLink mediator drives every viewer; only the viewer + its source adapter differ per tab.

items.name: json-form-sources-block
items.title: JSON Form Sources
items.description: Extraction rendered as a JSON form beside the source PDF — hover a form field to highlight where its value came from. Composes json-form and the PDF viewer through useSourceLink; data is the Retab /v1/extractions/{id}/sources response.

items.name: pdf-thumbnail-sidebar
items.title: PDF Thumbnail Sidebar
items.description: A page-thumbnail rail for the PdfViewer left slot: lazy pdfjs thumbnails, active-page highlight, click-to-jump. Reuses the viewer’s cached document.

items.name: primitive-cards-block
items.title: Primitive Run Cards
items.description: Each primitive's result framed as a run card — a document thumbnail with a status pill and the primitive's output in the body. Composes run-card with per-primitive result rendering; starts with classification and split.

items.name: legend-variants-block
items.title: Legend Variants
items.description: The split viewer shown with every legend placement — bar, floating, and a vertical rail — over one attention.pdf split result, all sharing one interaction state.

items.name: pdf-thumbnails-block
items.title: PDF Thumbnails
items.description: A PDF viewer with a toggleable page-thumbnail sidebar in the left rail slot.

items.name: source-field-list
items.title: Source field list
items.description: A field list that drives useSourceLink: hover previews a field's source in the viewer, click pins it. The emitter side of a source block.

items.name: image-source
items.title: Image source adapter
items.description: Bridges the document-source model to the image viewer: imageAnchorToArea, useImageSourceTarget, and renderImageSourceOverlay for image_bbox anchors.

items.name: text-viewer
items.title: Text Viewer
items.description: A bounded line-numbered text viewer for source-linked line ranges, with local load errors, explicit retry, and an imperative scrollToLineRange handle.

items.name: text-source
items.title: Text source adapter
items.description: Bridges the document-source model to the text viewer: textAnchorToLines, useTextSourceTarget, and sourceToTextHighlight for text_span anchors.

items.name: csv-source
items.title: CSV source adapter
items.description: Bridges the document-source model to the CSV viewer: csvAnchorToCell, useCsvSourceTarget, and sourceToCsvCell for csv_cell anchors.

items.name: xlsx-source
items.title: Excel source adapter
items.description: Bridges the document-source model to the xlsx viewer: spreadsheetAnchorToCell, useXlsxSourceTarget, and sourceToXlsxCell for spreadsheet_cell anchors (sheet-aware).

items.name: docx-source
items.title: DOCX source adapter
items.description: Bridges the document-source model to the docx viewer: useDocxSourceTarget and sourceToDocxHighlight for docx_text_span (located by content match) and docx_table_cell (located by index) anchors.

items.name: image-sources-block
items.title: Image Sources
items.description: Extracted fields linked to a scanned page image — hover to highlight the image_bbox region.

items.name: text-sources-block
items.title: Text Sources
items.description: Values extracted from a log file linked to the lines they came from — hover to highlight a line range.

items.name: docx-sources-block
items.title: DOCX Sources
items.description: Values extracted from a Word document linked back to where they came from — hover to highlight the text and scroll to it.

items.name: csv-sources-block
items.title: CSV Sources
items.description: Extracted values linked to spreadsheet cells — hover to highlight a cell and scroll to it.

items.name: xlsx-sources-block
items.title: Excel Sources
items.description: Extracted values linked to spreadsheet cells across sheets — hover to switch sheet, highlight the cell, and scroll to it.

items.name: source-indicator
items.title: Source indicator
items.description: A floating pill that reports the active field's source over a viewer: nothing selected, a located field (its path with a search icon), or a field with no source. Mount inside a relative viewer pane; feed from useSourceLink.
